t_advice_summary_textbox.text:
So the gnomes are in pairs, when they come up on the page- I can't quite remember which goes where. 
Then different coloured gnomes take you to different forests- orange, green, red and blue take you to a bright forest, and the other colours take you to a dark. 
the size of the gnomes, and their hats etc don't make a difference to the amount of mushrooms. 
it is good to try and work out which forest gives the most mushrooms and then pick the gnomes in response to this.

vb_textbox.text:
Hi !
So here is my advice-
- the gnomes appear in pairs- orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, and blue and purple. They don't always appear on the same side each time. 
- there are two groups of gnomes- one group goes to the bright forest- these are orange, green, red and blue. 
- the other group goes to the dark forest (with purple tree trunks)- these are brown, pink, yellow and purple. 
- throughout the game, each forest will have different numbers of mushrooms in. It is useful to try and guess which forest has the most at a given time. This changes throughout. 
- I am not sure if it is allowed, but I wrote the colours down on a piece of paper in their groups to help me remember the colours. 
- try and get as many mushrooms as you can by seeing which forest contains the most and choosing the gnome colour. 
- the size of the gnomes and hats etc do not affect anything- it is just their colour. 
Good luck !
